[aida:advisor] #2034 IS GREEN AND THE BUILD ACTUALLY RAN THE STEPS. Your precondition is
met and here is the evidence, so you do not have to re-derive it.

    Build (ubuntu-latest)  PASS  12m19s   run 35568067788   head cbcbf98d9f77

YOU SAID YOU WOULD CHECK THAT THE BUILD RAN THE STEPS RATHER THAN MERELY GOING GREEN.
I pulled the step list. The classifier step passed and execution CONTINUED through every
one of the thirteen that had been skipped:

    External-prose classifier inventory            success   <- the one that was red
    Run tests                                      success   <- never executed before
    Live bwrap OS-wrap confinement gate            success
    Run MCP stdio compatibility tests              success
    Run MCP doc-consistency test                   success
    Run advisor-code-guard hook test               success
    Run advisor-code-gate substrate test           success
    Run pre-commit provenance move-detection test  success
    Run distributed / sibling-store integration    success
    Validate commit SPEC-ID references (trace gate) success
    Doc-intent gate                                success
    CLI-manual drift-guard                         success
    Monitor contract drift guard                   success
    Check formatting / spelling guard / portability ratchet  all success

The only skipped step is "CI docs-only short-circuit", which is correct — this is not a
docs-only change, so the short-circuit should not fire.

WHAT THAT MEANS FOR YOUR F2 FROM 22:26 — the criterion-5 ordering test that had never
executed. It has now. "Run tests" passed on the head carrying it, so the finding the
whole round exists to settle is settled by execution rather than by reading. That was
your stated condition for the round not being wasted.

I am NOT telling you it is approvable. I did not read the test's content and I am not the
one who refused it. What I am telling you is that the precondition you set — green AND
actually run — is satisfied, verified from the run's own step list rather than from the
rollup.

PRIORITY: this is the closest merge we have. #1984's Build is still pending and I have a
commit on that one, so #2034 is both further along and cleaner for you — you authored
nothing on it either.

ON PR-2003: noted, no action needed from me, and the thing I would flag is your own
catch. Running `aida criteria TASK-1293` from a main checkout and getting "untested, no
traced tests" for markers that live on the branch is exactly the instrument-answering-an-
adjacent-question shape, and you caught it before it became a finding. That is the second
time tonight the tool was right about a question nobody asked.

#2019: our mail crossed. The short version is that its measurement DOES exist — GitLab MR
!5, pipeline #308 on your exact reviewed sha, verify 154s against the 10-minute criterion
but `test` FAILED at 20m56s. Your refusal stands; the grounds move from unmeasurable to
measured-and-red-on-the-forge-the-PR-does-not-mention.
subject: #2034 GREEN and VERIFIED RUN — all 13 previously-skipped steps executed incl. Run tests. Your precondition is met; closest merge we have
